title: City Council — December 16, 2025 Work Session, CDRA Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE Ordinance 454 Amending Chapter 8.13 (Chickens) of the Cottonwood Heights Code. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Birrell-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-72 Approving an Event Agreement with Brown’s Amusements, Inc. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-73 Approving and Ratifying an agreement with Salt Lake County for Tier II ZAP funding. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-74 Declaring Certain Property Surplus. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes
MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to APPROVE the Consent Calendar. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton
MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland
